question: Find the first name and gender of student who have more than one pet.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.fname ,  T1.sex FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid GROUP BY T1.stuid HAVING count(*)  >  1
generated_sql:
SELECT S.Fname, S.Sex
FROM Student S
JOIN Has_Pet HP ON S.StuID = HP.StuID
GROUP BY S.StuID, S.Fname, S.Sex
HAVING COUNT(HP.PetID) > 1;
